angle_en: Eleven roles that Krishna claims as his own
angle_hi: ग्यारह भूमिकाएँ जो कृष्ण अपना दावा करते हैं

en.intro: Krishna now lists eleven roles he fills, from the start of creation to its end. Listen to how he names himself as the goal, the shelter, and the seed.
en.notice: Krishna lists eleven roles and claims them all. He is the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the dwelling, the refuge, the well-wisher, the source, the dissolution, the resting place, the treasure, and the imperishable seed.
en.next: Krishna then says he heats the world as the sun, holds back the rain, and is both immortality and death.
en.meaning: I am the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the refuge, the friend, the source, the dissolution, the resting place, the treasure, and the imperishable seed.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अब ग्यारह भूमिकाओं की सूची देते हैं जो वे पूरी करते हैं, निर्माण की शुरुआत से लेकर उसके अंत तक। सुनिए, वे खुद को लक्ष्य, आश्रय और बीज के रूप में कैसे पुकारते हैं।
hi.meaning: मैं ही लक्ष्य, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, शरण, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान और अविनाशी बीज हूँ।
hi.notice: कृष्ण ग्यारह भूमिकाएँ बताते हैं और उन सब पर अपना अधिकार जताते हैं। वे लक्ष्य, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, शरण, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान और अविनाशी बीज हैं।
hi.next: कृष्ण आगे कहते हैं कि वे सूर्य के रूप में जगत को तापते हैं, वर्षा को रोकते और छोड़ते हैं, और अमरता तथा मृत्यु दोनों हैं।

en.intro: Krishna now lists eleven roles he fills, from the start of creation to its end. Listen to how he names himself as the goal, the shelter, and the seed.
en.body: I am the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the refuge, the friend, the source, the dissolution, the resting place, the treasure, and the imperishable seed. Krishna lists eleven roles and claims them all. He is the goal, the supporter, the lord, the witness, the dwelling, the refuge, the well-wisher, the source, the dissolution, the resting place, the treasure, and the imperishable seed. Krishna then says he heats the world as the sun, holds back the rain, and is both immortality and death.

issues: meaning_changed: "मैं ही लक्ष्य, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, आश्रय, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान और अविनाशी बीज हूँ।" (The Hindi meaning drops the word 'शरणम्' (refuge/shelter) from the list of eleven roles. The source Sanskrit lists eleven roles, and the English meaning also includes 'refuge'. The Hindi translation only lists twelve items but omits 'refuge' (शरणम्), and the word 'आश्रय' (shelter) is used instead of 'शरणम्', slightly altering the specific terminology.)

However, the Hindi translation lists twelve items (लक्ष्य, भर्ता, प्रभु, साक्षी, निवास, आश्रय, सुहृद्, उत्पत्ति, प्रलय, स्थान, निधान, अविनाशी बीज).
